title: India clinch a thriller against Australia in the final over
excerpt: The lower order held its nerve to seal the series with two balls to spare.
body: India held their nerve in a tense finish, with the lower order seeing the side home with two balls to spare. The win seals the series and keeps the home record intact this season.
The chase was built on a steady middle-order stand before a late flurry of boundaries swung momentum.
quote: We trusted the process right till the last ball.
author: Sports Desk
